description: MVP market-data generator config (iap.mvp.feed over iap.marketdata.generator, unmodified): seed 12345 (overridden by mvp.json seed / --seed so that one seed drives the whole run), ONE session, equities only (the MVP reference data lists no FX instrument, so the generator's FX branch emits nothing). The MVP instrument SYN.EQ.AAPL trades on XV1/XV2/XV3; each venue stream gets slots_per_stream EXPECTED flow slots spread over the whole mvp.json session window (flow.calibration "session", x-version 2: the base rate is calibrated for the self-excitation and flow runs to the close; up to v1.3.0 the slot budget was spent about a third of the way into the session). The QC anomaly injection stays at the bundled rates so the loop exercises sequence-gap gating (SNAPSHOT recovery -> risk on_sequence_gap / on_feed_recovered), duplicates and out-of-order arrivals; the intraday halt targets the MVP instrument itself so the venue trading-state gate (simulator rule 8, SOR eligibility, NO_ROUTE) is exercised too.
